description: VibePromptRig passive-listening signal taxonomy. 12 categories, Tier-1 regex + Tier-2 Haiku escalation. v4.4.5 adds negative_patterns + meta_context_exclusions to cut false-positive rate.

signals.description: User asking Claude to redo, redesign, or pivot what was just built
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(redesign|rewrite|rebuild|redo|start over|different approach|from scratch|pivot|scrap this|throw this out|do it again|try again|this isn't right)\b
signals.auto_action: If 3+ REWORK signals in a session, suggest /audit-gate or hostile-architect review

signals.description: User correcting a factual or design error Claude made
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(no,?\s+that's|wrong|not right|that's not|incorrect|you missed|not what I|that's wrong|actually it|no that|nope)\b
strength_markers: (?i)\b(actually|I said|I meant|I told you|the correct|it should be)\b
signals.auto_action: Log; if pattern matches existing rule, flag as potential rule violation

signals.description: Claude doing something it was already told not to do. Hardened v4.4.5 with negative patterns for past-tense recap.
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(you keep [a-z]+ing\b|you keep (doing|making|breaking)|I already told you|for the (\d+|second|third|nth) time|still (doing|breaking|making)|you('?re| are) still|keep doing this|I said (don't|never|stop)|how many times|stop doing (this|that))\b
negative_patterns: (?i)\b(used to|previously|in the past|last time|history of|past sessions?|recurring (pattern|theme|issue) (in|from) (history|the past))\b
signals.auto_action: HIGH PRIORITY — if prior lesson exists for this pattern, auto-promote to rule candidate

signals.description: User reporting a bug, error, or broken behavior
signals.auto_action: Auto-append to errors-fixed.json as a new entry with status: INVESTIGATING

signals.description: User flagging a security incident, data leak, or policy violation. Only fires on token-shape OR explicit incident phrasing (hardened v4.4.5).
signals.auto_action: IMMEDIATE — notification hook fires, logs SEC-incident entry, prompts token rotation

signals.description: User pointing out something Claude omitted
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(you missed|you forgot|didn't include|where('?s| is) the|what about|you left out|where did the|missing from|not included|forgot to|you never added)\b
signals.auto_action: Log + cross-reference against this rule type's checklist

signals.description: Claude misunderstood; user re-explaining the same concept
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(let me (re-?explain|restate|clarify|be clear|rephrase)|what I (mean|meant|said|want)|to be clear|I mean|what I('?m| am) saying|not what I asked|that's not what|you misunderstood)\b
signals.auto_action: Log; if 3+ in session, surface prompt-template improvement suggestion

signals.description: User expressing frustration with Claude's output or behavior
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(ugh|why (do you|does this|can't you)|annoying|frustrating|wtf|this is stupid|I hate this|come on|seriously\?|are you kidding|for the love of|this sucks)\b
signals.auto_action: Aggregate; track per-vertical frustration density for weekly synthesis

signals.description: User does not understand Claude's output or explanation
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(I don't understand|what does this mean|huh\?|confused|confusing|makes no sense|what('?s| is) (going on|this|that)|explain|I('?m| am) lost|what do you mean|say that again)\b
signals.auto_action: Log; signal explanation-gap in output style

signals.description: User explicitly approving Claude's output — positive signal
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(great|perfect|yes that('?s|) it|exactly|nailed it|that('?s| is) (great|perfect|what I wanted|correct|right)|love it|this is good|works|this works|ship it)\b
signals.auto_action: POSITIVE — log the pattern that worked; promote to golden-paths candidate if 3+ approvals for same pattern

signals.description: User changing direction at a project or feature level
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(let('?s| us) pivot|different direction|rethink (this|the|our)|kill this|park this|scrap the (plan|feature|idea)|change direction|going a different|new approach|forget (this|the) (plan|idea|feature|approach))\b
signals.auto_action: Project-level event — update CURRENT_SPRINT.md with PIVOTED status; update project BRIEF.md

signals.description: User accusing Claude of violating a VibePromptRig rule. Requires accusatory framing (not just rule citation). Hardened v4.4.5 to drop bare 'rule \d+' matches.
tier1_patterns: (?i)\b(you (just |literally |again |again, )?(broke|violated|ignored|bypassed) (rule|the rule|vibe|factory|VIBE \d+)|you('?re| are) not supposed to|you shouldn't (have|be)|you (always|keep) (doing|breaking)|against (the|our) (rules?|policy)|that('?s| is) not allowed|you weren't supposed)\b
signals.auto_action: HIGHEST PRIORITY — log + audit rule enforcement; if specific rule cited, flag for rule-strengthening review
